item.title: 'I just want to be able to sleep': Attacks in Iran rock cities and cut power
item.summary: Iranians in Tehran and Karaj tel the BBC they are exhausted and struggling to sleep after 10 days of Israeli and US attacks.

item.title: Five Iranian footballers granted Australian visas after anthem protest
item.summary: Concern has grown for team after one critic called them "wartime traitors" for failing to salute during the Iranian anthem.

item.title: Lebanon calls for talks with Israel on plan to end Hezbollah conflict
item.summary: President Aoun outlines a path towards "permanent security and stability", as Israeli strikes targeting Hezbollah continue.

item.title: Iran's new leader has never been tested. He now faces an existential battle
item.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei, 56, enters power as the Islamic republic faces its most serious crisis.

item.title: Mixed messages from Trump leave more questions than answers over war's end
item.summary: The US president has tried to soothe nerves over oil and markets, but his comments still lack clarity, writes Anthony Zurcher.

item.title: Signal issues scam warning to users after hackers target officials
item.summary: Signal says its systems are secure but it is taking reports of targeted attempts to hack some officials "very seriously".

item.title: Madagascar military leader sacks cabinet in surprise move
item.summary: Col Randrianirina, who seized power last year, did not give a reason for dissolving his government.

item.title: Syrian ex-colonel in court on crimes against humanity charge
item.summary: Salem Michel Al-Salem, accused of crimes committed in Syria in 2011 and 2012, has been named for the first time.

item.title: Family of child injured in Canada school shooting sues OpenAI
item.summary: The family alleges the firm knew the perpetrator was planning a "mass casualty event" but failed to contact the authorities.

item.title: Volkswagen to cut 50,000 jobs as profits drop
item.summary: Europe's largest carmaker said post-tax profits had dropped to their lowest level since 2016.
